name: C080 Kẻ Giữ Ngã Rẽ (Quyền Trượng Chìa Khóa Ngược Thời Không)
prompt_ref:
Create a single-cell 1x1 reference sheet of a Mythic SSR dark-fantasy Crossroads Chronomancer's time-rewind key staff (Quyền Trượng Chìa Khóa Ngược Thời Không - C080 Kẻ Giữ Ngã Rẽ) following the exact square cell of the attached reference layout_guide_1x1.png.

COMPOSITION & ORIENTATION (100% MANDATORY):
- Draw ONE complete mythic chronos-key staff oriented DIAGONALLY from bottom-left (astral bronze and star-metal shaft) to top-right (a grand celestial skeleton-key head formed by two counter-rotating golden clockwork Möbius rings and a blazing cyan-gold time-portal core).
- Must show 100% of the entire staff from bottom tip to top chronos-key head with generous padding inside the frame (occupying 65%-75% of the canvas).
- Zero clipping at canvas edges.

COLOR & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) edge-to-edge.
- DO NOT use any magenta/pink tones on the staff itself (use celestial gold, dark star-metal, antique bronze, and brilliant cyan-blue & amber-gold temporal energy).
- No character hands, no text, no borders.
prompt_anim_2x2:
Create a 2x2 sprite sheet (4 frames total: row 1 left-to-right, row 2 left-to-right) of the EXACT SAME Crossroads Time-Rewind Key Staff from the first attached reference image, following the 2x2 grid layout of the second attached reference image (layout_guide_2x2.png).

100% CONSISTENCY & ANIMATION RULES:
- Every cell must show the exact same diagonal chronos-key staff at the exact same angle, size, and position.
- Animate a looping 4-frame mythic time-rewind vortex: counter-spinning golden clock hands, reverse cyan-gold temporal ripples, and glowing constellation runes around the key head.
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) in all 4 cells. DO NOT draw the blue layout guide lines or cell borders. Keep each frame strictly inside its cell with zero clipping.
prompt_card:
Create a wide horizontal 16:11 dark-fantasy card illustration featuring the exact same Crossroads Time-Rewind Key Staff (Quyền Trượng Chìa Khóa Ngược Thời Không - C080 Kẻ Giữ Ngã Rẽ) from the attached reference images.

COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Place the mythic golden clockwork key staff diagonally across the center of the horizontal frame.
- Full atmospheric dark-fantasy background (100% opaque RGB illustration, NO magenta, NO transparency): a mystical dimensional crossroads where rivers of cyan-and-gold starlight and giant spectral clock gears rewind backward in time around the staff.
- Do NOT draw any card frame, borders, or text.
